[LIMP.2.2.2] **A trailing comma after the last name is permitted in
BOTH selective forms** — parenthesised or flat. `from ha import a,`
and `from ha import (a,)` are equally legal.

Authors use the multi-line form when the comma list exceeds reasonable
single-line width; the spec does not specify a column threshold.

The flat form admits the trailing comma as the parenthesised one does
([LIMP.2.1.1]'s `import_list`): the two forms differ only in line breaks, and a
rule that changed with them would be a trap.
